description: Look up a domain's registration in the registry (RDAP, or WHOIS for .ru/.su/.рф): expiry date and days left, registrar, creation date, EPP status codes (clientHold, redemptionPeriod, transfer locks…) with explanations, nameservers and DNSSEC. Use to check when a domain must be renewed or why it suddenly stopped resolving. Subdomains are reduced to the registered domain. For DNS records use check_dns.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com or пример.рф

name: check_domain_expiry

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: Domain registration / expiry
